    • activeModel

      Optional<ModelSnapshot> activeModel()
      Returns the model owned by the active MODEL document only.

      This is empty for animation scene, game-data, physics, and other documents, even when those documents reference or preview a Live2D model.

    • isHostPresent

      boolean isHostPresent()
      Returns whether the backing snapshot source currently observes a host session — in practice whether a project or document is visible to it. This is the source's observability signal, not a guarantee that a physical host connection is alive.

    • coreRuntime

      default CoreRuntimeInfo coreRuntime()
      Returns permission-checked Cubism Core metadata and MOC inspection.

      The default is the CoreRuntimeInfo.unavailable() sentinel, matching the facade's other optional accessors.

    • model

      default CubismModelAccess model()
      Returns the unified model object API.

      The default is the CubismModelAccess.unavailable() sentinel: it keeps implementations without a Runtime backend fail-closed instead of throwing from the accessor itself.

    • authoringTransactions

      @CubismEditor(from="5.0.00") default AuthoringTransactionService authoringTransactions()
      Returns the synchronous Editor-owned authoring transaction service — the recommended entry for grouped or batched writes that must share one Editor Undo unit.

      Single parameter writes do not need it: model().active().parameters().find(id) .setValue(v) is already validated and undoable on its own.

      The default fails closed and never executes work outside a verified transaction scope.

      Returns:
      synchronous authoring transaction service

    • edit

      @Incubating @CubismEditor(from="5.1.02", to="5.3.99") default EditSessionService edit()
      Returns the external-application editing session service.

      The default fails closed: sessions opened through it admit no operations until a Runtime backend with verified editor bindings is installed.

      Returns:
      the editing session service

    • warpMirror

      @CubismEditor({"5.0.00","5.0.01","5.0.02","5.0.03","5.0.04","5.0.05","5.0.06","5.1.00","5.1.01","5.1.02","5.1.03","5.2.00","5.2.01","5.2.02","5.2.03","5.3.00","5.3.01","5.3.02","5.3.03","5.3.04"}) default WarpMirrorService warpMirror()

    • textureAtlasPolygonLayouts

      @CubismEditor({"5.2.03","5.3.00","5.3.01","5.3.02","5.3.03","5.3.04"}) default TextureAtlasPolygonLayoutService textureAtlasPolygonLayouts()
      Returns polygon-aware texture-atlas layout access when installed.

      Snapshots carry item outlines from the host's model-image contour source (or a flagged bounds fallback), per-item layout policies and issued transforms; apply writes arbitrary-angle, scaled placements through the same affine/undo boundary as the rectangle service.
